title: Twilight Grove
wikitext:
[[File:Twilight Grove.jpg|thumb|300px|Twilight Grove]]

The '''Twilight Grove''' sits in the middle of [[Duskwood]] and contains a [[Great Tree]]. It is home to one of the four portals to the [[Emerald Dream]] and is guarded by the lieutenants of [[Ysera]]'s [[Green dragonflight]].

The Twilight Grove also contains a moonwell and a night elf gazebo. The other three dream portals can be found in [[Feralas]], the [[Hinterlands]], and [[Ashenvale]].
